usages.explain: This is a way to give an example. It's used when avoiding speaking explicitly, implying that there are many other possibilities. Often used in casual conversations among young people.

examples.content: 変だね、まだ誰も来てないよ。約束、午後だったりして。
examples.transcription: へんだね、まだだれもきてないよ。やくそく、ごごだったりして。
examples.mean: That's strange, no one has come yet. I promised it would be in the afternoon.

examples.content: 山田さん、遅いわね。事故にあったりして。
examples.transcription: やまださん、おそいわね。じこにあったりして。
examples.mean: Yamada-san, you're late. I had an accident.

title: …たりして => maybe, It could be, it is possible that…
